title: When the Postcards Falls
author: Astrid Brightwater
blurb: Noor Villalobos, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has spent twelve years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the demolition date arrives.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
